findings.message: Dependency has known vulnerabilities (CVEs). Using packages with unpatched security flaws exposes the environment to known exploits.
findings.pattern: 🟡 SC4: OSV.dev unreachable, using static fallback (15 packages). Results may be incomplete. Set SKILLSPECTOR_OSV_TIMEOUT to increase timeout or check network connectivity to api.osv.dev.
findings.remediation: Update the dependency to a patched version that addresses the known CVE. Check OSV (osv.dev) or NVD for details on the vulnerability.

findings.message: Overly Broad Trigger: description clause 'Use when the user asks to "拆书" / "蒸馏一本书" / "把 XX 书做成 skill" / "把这个视频/播客/课程蒸馏成 skill" / "turn a book or video into skills" — i' activates on 'to', which is too short and may match unintended inputs
findings.remediation: Use specific, narrow trigger patterns that match only the skill's intended use case. Avoid single-word or common-phrase triggers.
